intro.en: Real plans and imagined situations use different forms of si.

titulo.en: A real plan or an imagined one?

texto.en:
For a real or possible condition, use **si + present**. The result can be in the present, future or imperative: **Si tengo tiempo, voy / iré / te llamo**.

For an imagined or unlikely situation, use **si + imperfect subjunctive**, then the **conditional**: **Si tuviera tiempo, viajaría más**. The situation is imagined; the speaker does not say it is impossible.

The imperfect subjunctive often comes from the third-person plural past: **tuvieron → tuviera**, **hicieron → hiciera**, **fueron → fuera**. Its endings are **-ra, -ras, -ra, -ramos, -rais, -ran**; remember the written accent in **habláramos**.

Do not put the conditional after **si** in these patterns: **Si tuviera tiempo, viajaría** (not *si tendría*).

filas: Si tengo dinero, voy de viaje.
Si tuviera dinero, iría de viaje.

nota.en: The second pattern can refer to an unreal present or an unlikely future.

frases.es: Si pudiera dejar el trabajo un año, viajaría por Sudamérica.
frases.en: If I could leave work for a year, I would travel around South America.
And what would you do with the flat?

frases.es: Si lo alquilara, tendría dinero para el viaje.
frases.en: If I rented it out, I would have money for the trip.

frases.es: Yo, si estuviera en tu lugar, lo hablaría con calma.
frases.en: If I were in your place, I would talk it through calmly.

frases.es: Marta lleva años pensando en hacer un viaje largo, pero nunca encuentra el momento.
frases.en: Marta has been thinking about taking a long trip for years, but she never finds the right time.

frases.es: Si tuviera seis meses libres, recorrería varios países en tren.
frases.en: If she had six months free, she would visit several countries by train.

frases.es: También aprendería algo de portugués antes de salir y buscaría alojamiento con tiempo.
frases.en: She would also learn some Portuguese before leaving and look for accommodation in advance.

frases.es: Su hermano le pregunta qué haría con su trabajo.
frases.en: Her brother asks what she would do about her job.

frases.es: Marta responde que, si pudiera trabajar a distancia, no tendría que dejarlo.
frases.en: Marta replies that if she could work remotely, she would not have to leave it.

frases.es: Por ahora solo tiene dos semanas de vacaciones, así que está preparando una ruta más corta.
frases.en: For now she only has two weeks of holiday, so she is planning a shorter route.

pregunta.en: What would Marta do if she had six months free?

Visit several countries by train.en: She would travel by train through several countries.

Leave her job immediately.en: She is considering options, not saying she would leave it.

pregunta.en: Why is Marta planning a shorter route now?

She only has two weeks off.en: The final sentence gives her current situation.

She cannot travel by train.en: The train is part of her imagined plan.

She has already visited every country.en: The text does not say this.

bloques.correcta: She only has two weeks off

pregunta.en: Which sentence best sums up the text?

Marta imagines a long trip but is planni.en: This combines her imagined plan and her current situation.

Marta has already moved abroad for work.en: The text describes an idea, not a completed move.

Marta does not want to travel by train.en: She would like to travel by train.

bloques.correcta: Marta imagines a long trip but is planning a shorter holiday for now

pregunta.en: Complete the imagined situation: if I had time, I would travel.

tuviera.en: Imperfect subjunctive after si; conditional in the result.

tendría.en: The conditional does not go in this si clause.

tengo.en: This would describe a real or possible condition.

bloques.frase: Si pudiera trabajar a distancia, no dejaría mi trabajo

traduccion.en: If I could work remotely, I would not leave my job.
